root_cause: Insufficient capacity / traffic overload caused by a 450% surge in request volume exceeding Cloud Run max instances and saturating CPU at 96%
evidence: Incoming request count increased from 600 rpm to 3300 rpm (450% spike)
CPU utilization spiked to 96% and memory climbed to 88%
480 REQUEST_QUEUE_FULL_THROTTLED logs indicating maximum instance limit reached with concurrent requests overflowing
contradictory_evidence: No code changes or revisions deployed prior to spike
Failures span all endpoints rather than an isolated buggy endpoint
blast_radius: Scope: service-wide affecting checkout-service across all endpoints. Region: regional (us-central1).
recommended_action: Temporarily increase Cloud Run max-instances scaling ceiling and enforce rate limiting or Cloud Armor throttling at the edge
additional_checks_required: Inspect incoming IP addresses and user agents in Cloud Run request logs for DDoS or crawler behavior
Evaluate Cloud Run autoscaling target concurrency settings
